chapter_title_en: The Bone-Melting Fan and a Social Trap
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 251: The Bone-Melting Fan Destroyed & Dong Xuan'er Plays Her Game
chapter_meta_description: The Ghost Spirit Sect's skulls devour the Yan Clan's deadly poison fan. Dong Xuan'er stirs up a fight over her, while Han Li observes, immune to her charms and utterly unbothered.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 251: Ghost Spirit Sect Dominates the Duel
og_description: A top-grade magical tool is destroyed by sinister skull magic. Meanwhile, Dong Xuan'er plays two lovesick cultivators against each other. Han Li just wants out of the drama.
twitter_title: RMJI 251: Poison Fans vs. Ghost Skulls—No Contest.
twitter_description: The Bone-Melting Fan gets turned into a useless stick. Dong Xuan'er proves she's more dangerous with words than most cultivators are with swords.

lore_anchors.definition: A top-grade Yan Clan magical tool that releases a dense, flesh-melting poisonous mist. Its power is permanently reduced when its mist is devoured by an opposing technique.
A magical tool owned by Senior Brother Feng, claimed to be more powerful than the Bone-Melting Fan.
A famous but highly restrictive magical tool that requires both Wind and Thunder elemental mutated spiritual roots to operate, making it unusable for most cultivators.
A common spiritual root affinity; many moderate-quality artifacts are designed specifically for Wood cultivators to ensure broad usability.
A sinister sect whose cultivators use ghost-based techniques; in this chapter, they dominate five matches, winning four against the Yan Clan.
The elite combat division of the Yan Clan, housing their fearsome Blood Cultivators; the Ghost Spirit Sect explicitly requests to face them.
The Yan Clan’s most formidable fighters, reputed for their ruthless and powerful blood-based arts.
A cultivation technique that enhances the user’s natural allure to cloud the judgment of others; effective even on Foundation Establishment cultivators, as demonstrated by Dong Xuan’er.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Dong Xuan'er's bewitching charm work on Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The novel implies it is due to Han Li's unusual mental fortitude or a hidden property of his cultivation technique; for her part, Dong Xuan'er is equally baffled.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to the Bone-Melting Treasure Fan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Its poisonous mist was completely devoured by the Ghost Spirit Sect disciple's skull magic, permanently reducing the fan's power and rendering it much weaker than before.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Ghost Spirit Sect Junior Sect Leader suggest postponing the remaining fights?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is deliberately provoking the Yan Clan, stating he wants to test their famous Blood Cultivators from the Life-and-Death Hall—a clear escalation in the power display.
